title: Node postinstall 白名单 + Rust build.rs audit
description:
收窄任意代码执行面.

Node: 添加 pnpm/npm 的 `onlyBuiltDependencies` 白名单 (若使用 pnpm), 仅允许必要 native module 跑 postinstall (better-sqlite3 / etc, 若无则空数组).

Rust: 扫 rust/**/build.rs 存在性, 写 docs 记录每个 build.rs 的用途 (防止 upstream crate 悄悄加).
新脚本: scripts/audit/list-build-rs.sh 输出 rust workspace 内所有 build.rs + 大小 + 首行注释.

Cindy 参考: `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies` 白名单收窄到 4-6 个 essential native module.
acceptance: node/package.json 有 pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies 数组 (即使空)
scripts/audit/list-build-rs.sh 可执行, 输出所有 build.rs 清单
docs/reference/build-rs-inventory.md 存在, 每个 build.rs 一行说明
CI 一步: bash scripts/audit/list-build-rs.sh > /tmp/build-rs.txt && diff 对齐 inventory

node_pnpm_block_added.rationale: better-sqlite3 is a direct dep with native binding; esbuild is transitive via tsx/vitest and downloads platform binary via postinstall. No other native packages present in dep tree (no bcrypt/sharp/node-pty/fsevents/deasync/sqlite3).
